+def test_balance_of_one_account(bank):
+    client = login(bank["app"], bank["owner"])
+    eur_id = next(a["id"] for a in client.get("/api/accounts").json() if a["currency"] == "EUR")
+    response = client.get(f"/api/balance?account_id={eur_id}")
